errors.text_span: в по-късните слоеве (напр. около 19–23) са видими комбинации от оранжеви, зелени и червени сегменти с различни височини
errors.evidence: This statement describes the 'Text' chart. However, in the 19-23 range, layer 19 does not contain a red segment (Expert 4) and layer 23 does not contain an orange segment (Expert 2). Therefore, generalizing that a combination of orange, green, and red is visible is incorrect.
While layers 11 and 13 are entirely red (Expert 4), layer 15 in the 'Image' chart is not. Layer 15 clearly has a blue segment (Expert 1) at the bottom, which constitutes about 10% of the bar.

errors.text_span: при слой 17 има малък син сегмент в основата и основно червен сегмент до 100%
errors.evidence: In the 'Image' chart, the bar for layer 17 does not contain any blue segment (Expert 1). It is composed of an orange segment (Expert 2) at the bottom (approximately 50%) and a red segment (Expert 4) at the top.

errors.text_span: при слоеве 19–23 се наблюдават многокомпонентни натрупвания (синьо/оранжево/зелено/червено)
errors.evidence: This statement describes the 'Image' chart. However, none of the layers in the 19-23 range contain all four colors (blue, orange, green, red). Layer 19 is missing orange, and layers 21 and 23 are missing red. The generalization is inaccurate.

errors.text_span: in diesen Farben von unten nach oben gestapelt
errors.evidence: The description claims the stacking order is fixed (blue, orange, green, red from bottom to top), but the stacking order varies between bars. For example, in the 'Text' chart for index 7, green (Expert 3) is at the bottom, below orange (Expert 2).
For the 'Text' chart at index 3, the bar is composed of approximately 20% orange (Expert 2) and 80% green (Expert 3), not 80% blue (Expert 1).
For the 'Text' chart at index 13, the bar is predominantly green (Expert 3), not red (Expert 4).
For the 'Text' chart at index 7, the orange (Expert 2) segment constitutes about 60% of the bar, not 80-90%. The description also omits the red (Expert 4) segment which makes up about 20%.

errors.text_span: bei 19 überwiegend blau (ca. 70–80 %) mit kleineren grünen und roten Anteilen
errors.evidence: For the 'Image' chart at index 19, the bottom segment is blue (Expert 1, approx. 75%), the middle segment is green (Expert 3, approx. 15%), and the top segment is orange (Expert 2, approx. 10%). The description incorrectly identifies the top segment as red.

errors.text_span: bei 21 überwiegend orange (ca. 65–75 %) mit kleineren grünen und blauen Segmenten
errors.evidence: For the 'Image' chart at index 21, the segments are blue (Expert 1), orange (Expert 2), and green (Expert 3). There is no blue segment in this bar.
